title: How to use COUNTIFS (count with multiple conditions)
task: Count rows that satisfy several conditions at once — orders that are East AND over $100.

excel.note: Range/criteria pairs, all ANDed. Same argument pattern for one condition or five.

explanation: COUNTIFS counts rows where every range/criteria pair is true. Three rows are "East" but only two of them are also over 100 (150 and 200 — the East row of 80 fails), so the count is 2. Unlike SUMIFS there's no separate value range — COUNTIFS just counts matching rows. All conditions are ANDed together; for OR logic, add separate COUNTIFS or use SUMPRODUCT. Criteria take comparisons (">100"), wildcards ("E*"), and cell references (">"&C1). Two date-bound pairs count rows in a period, and unlike the plain COUNTIF, the criteria ranges must all be the same size.
